name: Publish Public File
description: Publish a file to the Tachin public file service: place it in the synced Drive folder, wait for the sync pipeline to mirror it to GCS, and return the public URL. This is the ad-hoc hosting service, NOT the marketing website.

file_path.description: Local path of the file to publish

steps.title: Upload the file to the synced Drive folder
steps.description:
Upload ${file_path} into the public file service's Drive source folder (configuration.drive_source_folder). Place it under a subdirectory — root-level files are intentionally ignored by the sync service.

Use the subpath ${subpath} if provided, otherwise place it in an appropriately named subfolder.
steps.accept_criteria: File uploaded to a subdirectory of the Drive source folder. Drive file ID reported.

steps.title: Wait for sync and confirm the public URL
steps.description:
The sync pipeline mirrors Drive → GCS in ~60-90 seconds. Wait, then confirm the file is live at the public URL base (configuration.public_url_base + path).

```bash
sleep 90
curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "<public_url>"
```
Retry once after another 60s if not yet 200.
steps.accept_criteria: Public URL returns HTTP 200. The final URL is reported to the requester.
